original_finding_text:
- [P1] Guard the Git-backed test with the existing permission check — /Users/nv/repos/ubiquity/ai.ubq.fi/.codex-worktrees/issue-throughput-handoff-2026-09-06-g5a02cbbad3/tests/sentinel-orchestrator.test.ts:5758-5762
  `deno task test`, used by `.github/workflows/deno-deploy.yml`, grants neither filesystem write nor subprocess permissions. This new test unconditionally calls `createPlanAdvanceRepository`, so it fails with `NotCapable: Requires write access to <TMP>` and breaks deployment CI. Use the existing `ignore: matrixVerifierTestsIgnored` guard, as nearby Git-backed tests do; the canonical Sentinel harness grants the required permissions and will still execute it. The focused test fails without these permissions and passes with them.
normalization: Removed exact canonical worktree prefix from paths for repository-relative finding fingerprints.

findings.body: `deno task test`, used by `.github/workflows/deno-deploy.yml`, grants neither filesystem write nor subprocess permissions. This new test unconditionally calls `createPlanAdvanceRepository`, so it fails with `NotCapable: Requires write access to <TMP>` and breaks deployment CI. Use the existing `ignore: matrixVerifierTestsIgnored` guard, as nearby Git-backed tests do; the canonical Sentinel harness grants the required permissions and will still execute it. The focused test fails without these permissions and passes with them.
